combiner.description:
Adds `require()` functionality which mimics standalone Lua's, allowing files to return values.
It will combine all required files into one output file.

tracing.description:
Tracing provides source error locations when an error occurs.
This will dramatically increase the size of the script! It's advised to not use in production.
If you do use in production to help find a bug, only use "simple" mode!

hookHttpReply.description: Also disables sending http request on port 0

anyOf.description:
Only traces function enter and exits.
Minor performance impact. (not negligible)

On-top of "simple", also traces *nearly* every single line.
Notable performance impact.
